title: Console UI: Shadow Evals dashboard MVP (charts, breakdowns, filters) + beta feature flag
creator: Dylan Brooks
description:
## Summary
Build the Console UI for the "Shadow Evals" dashboard MVP to visualize quality + performance metrics from shadow traffic runs (mirrored production-shaped requests executed asynchronously and non-blocking). The UI must be gated behind a beta feature flag and support basic filtering + breakdowns without creating metric-cardinality problems.

This ticket covers the front-end UX + wiring to Console backend query endpoints (ENG-2431). Telemetry pipeline/aggregation is handled in ENG-2427 and metric cardinality controls in ENG-2435.

## Goals (MVP)
- Provide a customer-facing (beta) dashboard that answers:
  - "Is shadow target better/worse than primary?" (judge win-rate / preference)
  - "Is output format adherence regressing?" (structured output / JSON validity / schema match where configured)
  - "Are safety outcomes changing?" (policy outcome rates)
  - "What is the latency/cost delta?" (shadow vs primary)
- Enable debugging views that are safe + low-cardinality (aggregated, not per-request).
- Ensure the UI is available only to allowlisted orgs and routes via feature flag; default OFF.

## Non-goals
- Per-request payload inspection / prompt-output viewing (handled via restricted logging workflow; out of scope for the dashboard).
- Building full A/B experiment management UI; this is a read-only eval/monitoring UI.

## Primary users
- ML/Platform engineers validating a model/version/quant profile change before rollout.
- Product engineers monitoring regressions during canary.

## UX scope
### Top-level IA
Console > Observability > Shadow Evals (beta)

### Required filters (MVP)
- Time range (last 1h/6h/24h/7d) + custom
- Route (required)
- Primary model (optional, if multiple primaries per route)
- Shadow target (required): {model/version/quant profile/prompt config name} as a single display label
- Region (optional)
- Customer segment / org (optional; only for internal + enterprise admin users; respects RBAC)

Notes:
- Filters must map to allowed query dimensions from observability standards. If the backend rejects a dimension, the UI should fail gracefully and show an actionable error.

### Dashboard panels (MVP)
1) Overview KPI row
- Shadow sample count (requests)
- Judge win-rate vs primary (with confidence interval if provided)
- Format adherence rate (or structured output success rate)
- Safety pass rate / block rate
- p50 / p95 latency delta (shadow - primary)
- Cost per 1k tokens delta (shadow - primary)

2) Time-series charts
- Judge win-rate over time
- Format adherence over time
- Safety outcomes over time
- Shadow execution latency p50/p95 over time (and/or delta series)

3) Breakdown tables
- By region
- By model variant (if shadow target maps to multiple underlying variants)
- By "policy bucket" (if available; e.g., tier/capacity bucket) 

4) States + guardrails
- Empty state: no data for selected range/filter; include copy pointing to "enable shadow traffic" docs.
- Partial data: if some metrics disabled (e.g., judge scoring not configured) show "Not configured" badges rather than zero.
- Error state: backend errors + throttling should present retry and request-id for support.

## Feature flagging (beta)
- Gate entire navigation entry + route behind `shadow_evals_beta` (org-level allowlist).
- Secondary flag for internal-only filters (org/customer dimension) behind `shadow_evals_internal_filters`.
- Ensure direct URL access is blocked when flag off (not just hidden nav).

## Data + API integration
- Use Console backend endpoints delivered in ENG-2431. Expect APIs roughly:
  - `GET /console/v1/shadow-evals/summary`
  - `GET /console/v1/shadow-evals/timeseries`
  - `GET /console/v1/shadow-evals/breakdowns`
- UI should pass only allowlisted dimensions/values; avoid passing raw request ids, prompts, or high-cardinality tags.

## Performance requirements
- Initial page render < 2s on typical broadband for default time window (24h) after cached assets.
- Avoid unbounded client-side transforms; rely on aggregated server responses.
- Charts should handle up to ~1k time buckets without freezing (downsample if needed).

## Accessibility + UX polish
- All charts must have accessible labels + keyboard navigable filter controls.
- Provide unit annotations (ms, tokens, $, %).
- Standard Console styling and empty-state patterns.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Shadow Evals dashboard accessible only when `shadow_evals_beta` is enabled for the org.
- [ ] Route + shadow target selection required; page loads default panels using backend APIs.
- [ ] Time-series panels render and update on filter/time changes.
- [ ] Breakdown table renders at least "by region" with sortable columns.
- [ ] UI handles missing metrics (judge not configured, safety disabled) with explicit "Not configured" state.
- [ ] No PII exposure: UI only uses aggregated metrics; no prompt/output content is displayed.
- [ ] Basic automated coverage: filter interactions + flag gating (unit + one e2e smoke).

## Design references
- Google Drive: `shadow-evals-dashboard-ux-notes` (PM/Design IA + terminology)
- Confluence PRD: Shadow Traffic eval metrics PRD (metric definitions + GA criteria)

## Implementation notes
- Prefer existing Console components: TimeRangePicker, RouteSelector, MultiSelect, StandardEmptyState.
- Consider a single query hook that fan-outs to summary/timeseries/breakdowns with request cancellation on filter changes.
- If timeseries endpoint supports multiple metrics per request, batch to reduce round-trips.

## Open questions
- Do we expose confidence intervals for judge win-rate in MVP or defer? (backend may not ship CI initially)
- How do we label shadow targets when multiple dimensions (model/version/quant/prompt config) are present? Proposed: single `shadow_target_display_name` string from backend.

comments: 2025-10-09 (Kenji Nakamura): Copy suggestion: avoid "Shadow Traffic" term in customer UI; recommend "Shadow Evals" with tooltip explaining requests are mirrored and do not affect responses. Also propose KPI row top-of-page with a short "Beta" pill and link to docs.

2025-10-15 (Jin Woo Park): Please do not add a free-form "tags" filter. Only allow filters that map to the aggregated table dimensions; we already saw cardinality risk in early drafts. If we need additional slicing, we can add specific allowlisted fields later.

2025-10-28 (Allison Grant): Ensure charts use the standard percent formatting and do not treat null as 0. For missing metrics, surface "not configured". Also add a link to the SRE overview dashboard for queue depth if available (internal-only is fine).

2025-11-04 (Chloe Martin): Backend is returning `shadow_target_id` + `shadow_target_display_name` and will reject unknown dims. UI should treat 400s as misconfiguration and show the error `code` + `request_id` to support.

2025-11-12 (Sean Gallagher): From SRE perspective, we need a quick sanity view: shadow drop rate and shadow runner errors. If those aren’t in the customer dashboard, at least have an internal-only panel or link to the SRE dashboard so on-call can triage beta customers without hunting.

2025-11-14 (Alicia Perez): Implemented basic page layout + filters + three charts. Added feature-flag gate at route-level and nav-level. Next: breakdown table, empty states, and one Cypress smoke. PR up: redwood#48333.

2025-11-18 (Marissa Cole): Reviewed staging screenshots—looks good for beta MVP. Please ensure terminology uses "Primary" vs "Shadow target" consistently and add a small note that judge scores are comparative and can be noisy at low sample sizes.
